Lemma
[evolution of the curvature-potential energy density] Source: cao-zhu 1. Lemma 5.1.2\group Normalized Ricci Flow on Surfaces

The function $h$ satisfies the evolution equation \begin{equation} \frac{\partial h}{\partial t}=\Delta h-2|M_{ij}|^2+rh. \end{equation}
